function: Predicts the next-slot ISAC transmit beamforming matrix from historical estimated channels, maximizing sum rate under CRLB sensing constraints (p. 6, 10).
system: D2D pairs, ULAs with Nt = Nr = 16, full-duplex ISAC, mmWave 76.5 GHz, 50 pairs in 1000 m x 1000 m; no RIS (p. 3, 11, 12).
method: LoRA blocked-LSTM Transformer feature extractor plus message-passing GNN and fully connected output block; unsupervised offline training with a penalty loss (p. 7, 10).
data_channel: Custom simulated LoS channel with steering vectors and path loss; 10,000 random D2D layouts for training, 1,000 for testing (p. 5, 11).
test_conditions: Trained with 50 pairs in 1000 m x 1000 m; tested with 100 to 1000 pairs at the same density (larger areas) and higher density (p. 12-14).
baselines: Random beamforming; perfect-CSI upper bound; LSTM_CNN-MPGNN [38]; naive downlink with fully connected network and outdated channel; unfrozen LoRA variant (p. 12).
metrics: Average achievable data rate versus power and number of pairs, rate ratio to upper bound, CRLB of angle and distance, TFLOPs (p. 12-14).
complexity: Complexity orders in Eqs. 30-35 (p. 10-11); 0.04 TFLOPs for LoRA_BLT versus 1.3 for LSTM_CNN and 1.72k for BLT (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 11: "we randomly generate 10,000 D2D network layout samples for training"; the channel is a custom LoS steering-vector model with path loss (p. 5), and no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data is named.
q2_support: p. 14: "For testing datasets with different values of Z, using the same trained LoRA_BLT-MPGNN model"; p. 12: "is trained with 50 pairs in this region", then tested with 100 to 1000 pairs (Fig. 8, Tables III-IV).
q3_support: p. 12: "A random beamforming scheme is adopted" and "a CNN integrated with LSTM and MPGNN is developed to facilitate effective predictive beamforming" [38]; Fig. 7 compares all methods on the average achievable data rate.
q4_support: p. 14: "requiring only 0.04 TFLOPs, an impressive reduction" (32x versus LSTM_CNN); p. 10-11 give the complexity orders in Eqs. (30)-(35).
q5_support: p. 11: "we randomly generate 10,000 D2D network layout samples for training"; the data are self-generated and no code or data link appears anywhere in the 15 pages.
notes: Area 5: the learned model outputs ISAC precoders trained with a CRLB-penalized rate loss (p. 6, 10). RIS appears only in related work (p. 2), not in the system. Baseline [38] is a 2022 arXiv CNN-LSTM-MPGNN predictive beamformer (p. 12). Table III areas imply about 80,000 m2 per pair, whereas the stated training is 50 pairs in 1000 m x 1000 m (20,000 m2 per pair); the paper does not reconcile this (p. 13-14).
